name: QoL
description: Everyday helpers: middle click item use, one key to switch every module off, chat macros, respawn and reconnect, fishing, lower frame limit when unfocused, screenshots on kills and deaths, a crash guard, and developer recorders.

addons.MiddleClick: Middle click uses a chosen hotbar item (pearl, rod or golden apple). Leaves the friend toggle alone when you aim at a player.
addons.PanicKey: One key turns every other module off, and back on when pressed again.
addons.AutoRespawn: Presses Respawn after a random delay when you die.
addons.ChatMacros: Sends a chat line when a key is pressed, written as KEY=message pairs.
addons.AutoReconnect: Reconnects to the last server after a disconnect, with a delay and a retry limit.
addons.AutoFish: Casts a fishing rod and reels in when you get a bite.
addons.PacketLogger: Developer tool: logs sent and received packets with their fields to a daily file. Never changes packets.
addons.ClickRecorder: Developer tool: records your real clicks to a CSV file, for tuning CPS.
addons.RotationRecorder: Developer tool: records your real camera turns to a CSV file, for tuning silent rotation.
addons.BackgroundFps: Lowers the frame limit while the game window is not focused.
addons.AutoScreenshot: Takes a screenshot on a kill or on your death.
addons.AntiCrash: Drops incoming packets known to crash clients: oversized payloads and particle floods.
